item.title: Luxury Chalet Development Proposed at Lake Tahoe Ski Resort
item.description: A major expansion could be coming to one of Northern California’s most iconic luxury resorts.

item.title: Why 400 Miles of Fog Have Been Stuck Over California’s Heartland for a Week
item.description: A massive blanket of Tule fog—stretching nearly 400 miles from Bakersfield to north of Sacramento—has settled over California’s for a week.

item.title: This Lighthouse Has Looked Over the Northern California Coast for More Than 150 Years
item.description: Perched on one of the windiest, foggiest points in North America, the Point Reyes Lighthouse has stood watch over the Pacific for more than 150 years.

item.title: Do Giant Sequoias Need Saving? New Report Says Nature Is Already Doing the Job
item.description: A conservation group is urging Congress to reject the proposed Save Our Sequoias Act, arguing that giant sequoia forests are already showing strong natural recovery.

item.title: For One Day Only, You Can Cut Your Own Christmas Tree in South Lake Tahoe
item.description: If you want to cut your own Christmas tree in the Tahoe wilderness this year, there’s only one day to do it—and it’s happening at Lake Tahoe Community College.

item.title: New Species Found in Lassen Volcanic National Breaks the Rules of Life on Earth
item.description: A tiny creature living in the boiling hot pools of Lassen Volcanic National Park has stunned scientists by surviving temperatures hotter than what was ever thought possible for complex life.

item.title: Remembering the Serial Killer Who Terrorized Northern California Hikers in the 1980's
item.description: For 21 months, from 1979 to 1981, the hiking trails of Marin County and Santa Cruz County had been terrorized by a serial killer.

item.title: Whaleback Wolf Pack Adds 10 New Pups as Activity Grows Near Mount Shasta
item.description: California’s gray wolves continue their slow comeback, and the latest update from CDFW shows that Siskiyou County remains a hotspot for wolf activity.

item.title: When Will Snow Fall on Tahoe Again? Long Term Forecasts Look Disappointing
item.description: Tahoe’s early-season snow season is off to a sluggish start, with no measurable snowfall in more than 10 days and none expected for at least another week.
